statement: Fix n>=2, per-coordinate order vector D, Weil algebra W_D, vector-field lift L_D fixed to candidate (a) index-blind projection (background). M commutes with L_D if M[L_D(F)] = T_D(Phi_h^M[F]) identically in W_D. Test on {explicit Euler, RK2, RK4, implicit Euler, exact-jet Taylor} whether the identity holds, and whether a B-series/elementary-differential structural condition on M is necessary/sufficient.
argument_shape: none — round 1 of testing this specific claim; MAGI worked the test family directly (Opus, 5-min budget per agent, per user instruction).
outcome: gap-located + misframed (Melchior gap-found triggers row 1; Balthasar vacuous-or-trivial and Casper likely-misframed both trigger row 4)

carried_to_eve: Melchior: L_D(F) is only defined on the slice {x+t*e}; every >=2-stage method evaluates it off the slice, where the statement's own two readings of candidate (a) (a-full vs a-trunc) diverge (exact rational witness given in W_(1,2)); only explicit Euler stays on the slice, which is why an Euler-only sanity check hides the defect.

Melchior: the implicit solve for backward Euler is not 'a formula built by literal substitution,' so the licensing sentence doesn't actually cover it as stated; 'every h>0' is too strong for Phi_h^BE to exist as a real map.

Balthasar: under candidate (a), the hypothesis on M ('well-typed by literal substitution over any commutative R-algebra') IS ALREADY the sufficient condition (W_D is an ordinary Weil algebra; evaluation is an R-algebra homomorphism) — the conclusion is definitional, the test family cannot produce a failure, and D_1!=D_2 does no work at all under (a).

Balthasar: found a genuine counterexample to the NECESSITY half of the proposed B-series characterization — backward Euler is not a finite polynomial/B-series method (implicit, infinite series) yet commutes exactly and satisfies every stated hypothesis on M.

Balthasar: the minimal change making the question non-vacuous is widening M's admissible operations to non-algebra-homomorphism-preserved ones (norm/comparison, tolerance-based stopping, adaptive step control, root selection) — exactly what the current hypothesis excludes by construction.

Casper: convention (a) reduces the identity to product-preserving-functor naturality applied to a composite M is DEFINED to be built from; the D_1!=D_2 hypothesis does no work, the sought structural property restates the admissibility hypothesis (near-circular), and the test family has no negative control so necessity is unreachable by construction.

Untouched by all: RK4 specifically (Melchior), the asymptotic-in-h refinement, candidate lifts other than (a), n>=3, non-polynomial F, multistep/partitioned/symplectic/rational methods (Balthasar's scope note).
